pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft piano intro, quiet moonlit atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Moonlight slips through the window
touching the silent room
your fading scent still lingers
like a distant bloom

Even the door feels heavy
I cannot move away
your quiet tears are falling
in my heart tonight

[Chorus]
Your love was moonlight
fallen into a well
a trembling silver shadow
no hands could ever hold

While I was asleep
the night erased your trace
and in the deeper darkness
even the moonlight fades

[Verse 2]
The name I held inside my hand
I slowly let it go
like grains of drifting sand
slipping through my soul

When flowers bloom around you
I hope I won't remain
even in your memory
I'll fall like spring rain

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and gentle)

[Bridge]
Your seasons felt too heavy
so I became the snow
quiet as a falling leaf
I let the silence grow

Waiting far beyond the winter
where softer mornings start
hoping somewhere in the distance
spring will find your heart

[Chorus]
I erased your name with tears
so your sky stays clear
this farewell was the only gift
I could leave you here

If loving meant one thing
it was wishing you less pain
so I stepped into the shadows
and disappeared like rain

[Outro]
(soft emotional piano outro)

For your quiet spring
I chose this goodbye

now slowly
bloom again
